name: Helical Solenoid with Magnetic Field Lines
semanticDescription: Long helical coil of insulated copper wire carrying electric current, demonstrating uniform axial magnetic field lines inside and dipolar looping field lines outside (CBSE Class 10 Magnetic Effects Ch 12).
simplifications: Helical wire coils represented as 16 discrete turned helical segments.
Magnetic field lines depicted as axial parallel rays inside and curved dipolar loops outside.

materials.look: Glossy reddish-orange enameled copper magnet wire
Bakelite / acrylic insulating central support cylinder
Machined brass knurled terminal posts (red positive, black negative)
Luminescent cyan magnetic flux vector tubes
